user.title: Set up Boopli
user.description: Boopli adds a chore and task companion to your sidebar. Everything stays inside your Home Assistant, and nothing is sent anywhere else.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Creates a one-off task and starts it right away. It disappears once it is done.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Optional smaller steps. Without steps, the task has one step called like the title.

where.name: Where
where.description: Whether the task only makes sense at home or anywhere.

start_chore.name: Start chore
start_chore.description: Starts a chore now, for example an on-demand chore like laundry.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

complete_step.name: Complete step
complete_step.description: Marks the step that is waiting for you in a chore as done.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

snooze_step.name: Snooze step
snooze_step.description: Delays the next nudge for the step that is waiting for you in a chore. The step stays open.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

delete_chore.name: Delete chore
delete_chore.description: Deletes a chore and anything in progress for it.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

set_away.name: Set away mode
set_away.description: Boopli rests: scheduled chores do not start and nothing nudges you, except chores marked 'Keeps going while I'm away'. The pet does not get sad.

start.name: Starts
start.description: Local date and time it begins, like 2026-11-28 08:00. Leave empty to begin now.

until.name: Until
until.description: Local date and time it ends by itself. Leave empty to stay away until you end it.

end_away.name: End away mode
end_away.description: Back now: Boopli carries on, and frozen chores nudge again one after the other.
